logline: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.

moments.description: The aristocratic lord opens the conversation by reminding the trembling maid that her brother is alive because of Lady Juliana.
The Lord corners the terrified maid by ruthlessly threatening to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol before sunrise.
moments.key_dialogue: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.

moments.description: The Lord pressures the reluctant maid into twisting Lady Juliana's medical actions into suspicious rituals.
The Lord clinically categorizes Lady Juliana's healing actions as malicious witchcraft.
The maid realizes in horror that she is expected to deliver this fabricated testimony against her savior before the magistrate.
moments.key_dialogue: I never said she was a witch!

moments.description: The Lord delivers his final ultimatum forcing the maid to choose between her savior and her brother, causing her to collapse in total despair.
moments.key_dialogue: And now... you will save your brother.
